title: Replace the collapsed mechanism table with cards and fix the cache chapter terminology
source_handoff: external review of the Edition 1 draft, findings R01, R13-R18 (GPT-5.6 Sol, high effort, 2026-09-24)
acceptance_criteria: The three-column mechanism table is gone; each mechanism is a card carrying Race closed, Mechanism, Guarantee, Does not solve and Evidence
The cards are grouped by layer so source-mutation arbitration is separate from copy ordering
All four evidence-status classes the table carried are preserved, including the fill lease's unregistered-evidence status and the outbox's proposed/unmeasured status

No prose column in the chapter is narrow enough to hyphenate a word into 1-3 character fragments: orphan-hyphen fragment lines in the extracted page text fall from 99 (worst page 33 with 17) to no worse than a normal line-end hyphenation rate
The chapter no longer states that invalidation is a fence; the stale-fill race is named as the counter-example
The strict-after-acknowledgement contract is written formally with W1/ack(W1)/R1/begin(R1)
The wrong_reads counter is defined as a strict-comparator count over committed-but-older values and explicitly not corruption
A purpose matrix states per mechanism whether it addresses correctness, freshness, load or recovery
book/build.sh verifies with 29/29 claims indexed, all fonts embedded and the evidence digest present
expected_artifacts: mechanism-card and mechanism-group components in book/lib/config.typ
before/after fragment-line measurement and the build verification output
validation: the mechanism count, each mechanism's closed race and each evidence-status class are identical to the table's, checked by diffing the rendered sections
